The '''Giryulan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Atlas Online" /> where the [[Giryulan Findings]] took place.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Giryulan Findings]]|system=Giryulan [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Giryulan system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square U-6.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
